page_title: ROM 1-2 EMP | AS Roma v Empoli 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Enzo Le Fee (AS Roma) will deliver the corner kick.

90+6' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. Mile Svilar is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.

90+4' What a great touch by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
90+3' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

90' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
88' That will be all from Jacopo Fazzini who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Petar Stojanovic (Empoli).
87' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Lorenzo Colombo is replaced by Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli).
84' A yellow-coloured card is received by Liberato Cacace (Empoli).
83' The foul by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) was seen by Luca Zufferli who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
82' Corner kick. Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is ready to send the ball into the box.

82' Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) after a cross from the side. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.

80' 1 - 2 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Tommaso Baldanzi is pounced on by Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma). His close-range strike flashes past Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach and into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
79' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Luca Zufferli no option but to blow his whistle.
77' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
77' A substitution has been made. Matias Soule goes off and Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) comes on.

76' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Empoli.
72' The game is interrupted now, Enzo Le Fee (AS Roma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
70' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sends it out of play.
70' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. AS Roma have a corner.
67' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
67' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
66' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) releases a superb dipping volley at goal from the edge of the box that flies just wide of the right post.
65' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma).
63' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to make a change. Liberato Cacace (Empoli) replaces Giuseppe Pezzella.
63' Youssef Maleh goes off the pitch and Nicolas Haas (Empoli) comes on.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leandro Paredes departs the field of play to be replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Enzo Le Fee (AS Roma) replaces Bryan Cristante.
61' 0 - 2 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) into the top right hand corner, giving goalkeeper Mile Svilar no chance!
61' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

60' A clumsy foul by Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle. The referee gives a penalty to Empoli after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
58' The substitution is prepared. Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ola Solbakken.
58' Ola Solbakken (Empoli) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
56' The opposition back off Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
56' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

55' Matias Soule (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Matias Soule (AS Roma) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
54' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle as Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
53' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is able to continue to play.
52' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) attempts to knock in the rebound with his head. Unfortunately for him, his effort only hits the right post!
51' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) latches on to a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a brilliant shot towards the goal, but he hits the crossbar!
51' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
51' Matias Soule (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. AS Roma can continue in their attacking effort.
49' AS Roma control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) comes on the pitch for Zeki Celik.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' 0 - 1 GOAL! Lorenzo Colombo meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 0:1.
44' Matias Soule (AS Roma) zig-zags his way into the box and fires the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
43' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AS Roma comes to nothing.

43' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach, who pulls off a comfortable save! AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
42' AS Roma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
39' Angelino (AS Roma) sends a short pass into the box, Lorenzo Pellegrini takes a touch to control the ball, but one of the defenders robs him of it and clears to safety.
38' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and it's Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
37' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
36' The game is interrupted. Liam Henderson (Empoli) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
33' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) trips an opposition player and Luca Zufferli signals a foul. AS Roma win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
32' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach intercepts the ball.
29' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
26' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Empoli.
23' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) is penalised for a foul. Luca Zufferli had a clear view and blows his whistle.
21' Empoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
20' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) is in a good position inside the six-yard box to head a rebound home, but he is not precise enough and the ball flies away off the bar.

20' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the right side of the goal, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Mile Svilar.
19' Matias Soule (AS Roma) sends a chip pass into the box, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach is quickest to intercept the ball.
18' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
15' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
13' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
11' Mattia Viti (Empoli) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
10' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
10' A quickly taken corner by Empoli.
9' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post.
9' Nice passing game by Empoli. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
7' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) fires a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the ball goes well wide of the left post.
7' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

6' A through ball from Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) fails to reach Artem Dovbyk as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Artem Dovbyk could have got into a promising position. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AS Roma.
5' A dangerous looking corner kick from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is cleared to safety by the defence.
5' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
4' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.

3' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
2' The AS Roma players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! AS Roma will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Luca Zufferli.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
